AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.label: Dominion Verdict Lens
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.description: A pale verdict lens that teaches a modular turret to recognize authority, mass and shielded command bodies before lesser targets can steal its attention.
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.effectSummary: Extends range and tightens tracking while strongly prioritizing bosses, constructs, mechanoids and shielded targets. Slightly slows the weapon cycle.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.label: Crown Overpressure Choir
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.description: A crown-fed pressure choir that drives the weapon path into a harsher rhythm, burning power and stability for a faster verdict cycle.
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.effectSummary: Greatly tightens the firing cycle, but shortens reach, slightly worsens miss geometry, increases incoming damage taken and draws heavy power.

AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.label: Sepulcher Fail-Safe Mantle
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.description: A sepulcher mantle of dead-brass clamps and black failsafe relays. It keeps a turret body standing when the shield has already spent itself.
AbyssalProtocol.ABY_TurretModuleDef.effectSummary: Reduces incoming damage and improves idle cooldown recovery for long siege cycles, but slows firing and narrows close-range safety geometry.
